definitions.gloss: at any rate, anyway, after all
definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize a reason or fact that explains a situation.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}しろ⟦{初|はじ}めて→はじめて：02932_hajimete⟧な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{緊張|きんちょう}している→きんちょうする：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: After all, it's my first time, so I'm nervous.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}しろ⟦{安|やす}い→やすい：00464_yasui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{人気|にんき}→にんき：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At any rate, it's cheap, so it's popular.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}しろ⟦{時間|じかん}→じかん：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ん⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The thing is, I just don't have time.

notes:
{何|なに}しろ is an adverb that introduces a key explanatory fact or reason.

USAGE:
Placed at the beginning of a clause to emphasize that the following reason is particularly important or compelling. Often translates as "after all," "you see," or "the thing is."
Implies that the reason given should make the situation obvious or understandable. Often used when justifying or explaining something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なに}しろ〜⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧/⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since/because (after all) ~
- {何|なに}しろ〜ん⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: the thing is ~
- {何|なに}しろ⟦{初|はじ}めて→はじめて：02932_hajimete⟧な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧: since it's my first time (after all)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦なにせ→なにせ：noentry⟧: variant form, slightly more casual
- ⟦とにかく→とにかく：03464_tonikaku⟧: anyway, anyhow (less explanatory)
- ⟦なんといっても→なんといっても：noentry⟧: above all, most importantly
